subject: Quick deadline check
text: Hi, sorry this is a bit messy, but I need a quick clarification about the deadline because I have just landed and my phone is behaving strangely. The project brief mentioned that the first draft was due at the end of the day, yet the shared schedule seems to shift everything forward by two hours, and I am not sure whether that is because of the room booking or the client call. I was travelling for the conference, but my train got delayed near the depot, and I missed the connection that would have let me work quietly on the train. I am now in the office with a bag of cold tea and borrowed laptop, so I am trying to piece together what still needs to happen before noon. Could you confirm whether the review meeting is still happening before we submit anything, and whether the revised timeline applies only to the summary slides or to the full appendix too? If I have misunderstood the sequence, I would rather be corrected now than send the wrong files to the wrong folder at this hour. I have marked the two chapters that still need citations, but I cannot tell whether those citations should appear in footnotes or in a separate bibliography file. Please reply with whatever is easiest: a sentence, a screenshot, or a note in the task board is fine. I do not need a long explanation, just enough to keep me from guessing wrongly and creating a bigger problem. Thanks for helping before my head gets even louder.
